verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents its own bulk-launch capability: launching many workflows at once through the REST API (ironclad-docs-37). Workflows carry contracts through approval and signature (ironclad-docs-5, ironclad-docs-15). This plausibly covers sending one template to many counterparties, but only as an API-driven, developer-oriented process, and the evidence never ties it explicitly to e-signature distribution. Missing for 10: a no-code bulk-send feature a legal-ops lead can run in-app, explicit confirmation that bulk launch sends the same document to many signers for e-signature, recipient-list/CSV handling and per-recipient tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
